answer: One enforceable rule: randomly force a peer to replay your full reasoning chain and compare method. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The prism of work and the oasis of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a signal to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
